intro.text: A sea voyage on Rysn Ftori's ship, the Wandersail, to Akinah, an Aimian city long thought lost, agreed between Rysn and Queen Navani Kholin.
The Wandersail's voyage to the lost Aimian city of Akinah, where its crew found an Oathgate and a Dawnshard, and brought back Soulcasters and Shardplate.

items.text: Talik told Rysn that her sickly larkin, Chiri-Chiri, should be taken to Akinah, the ancestral home of the larkin. Rysn recalled that Navani was looking for ships to sail to Aimia after the First Dreams had come back.

Rysn chose to take the job and had Queen Fen write to Navani about it. At Urithiru she first saw Talik about Chiri-Chiri, then settled the terms of the voyage with Navani, after which Fen sent the Wandersail's crew a writ about the expedition.

After Lopen had met Ral-na and Talik, Kaladin talked to him about the mission and he volunteered. Lopen then brought in Huio and Cord, and went to Rushu to hear Navani's confidential briefing on the voyage.

Before all this, Smta had found the First Dreams on another voyage, and a scouting party including Leyten, Lyn and Sigzil had tried to fly to Akinah, only for a hordeling in the weather around it to drain their Stormlight. Rysn, who wanted both a new voyage and help for Chiri-Chiri, toured the First Dreams while it was repaired in Thaylen City.

Rushu, Lopen, Huio and Cord came to Thaylen City through the Oathgate just before the ship sailed. The crew had just lost their pet skyeel, Screech, and saw it as a bad sign. Rysn let anyone who wished stay ashore with no penalty, but only three sailors did.
With everyone on board, the Wandersail left Thaylen City.
Some weeks out, Cord found worms in every barrel of lavis grain, and the crew took it as another omen. Rysn calmed them by trading the spoiled grain to Hexi nomads for jerky.

Rysn's porter Nikli was secretly Nikliasorm, one of the Sleepless, and had been behind the dead skyeel and the worms. He consulted Yelamaiszin, whose lead eighteen other Sleepless followed, and they agreed to let him try a final omen before turning to harsher methods.

Tinkering with Rushu's spanreeds, Huio found that aluminum had an effect on conjoined fabrials. Soon afterwards the crew spotted a dead santhid, which broke apart into hordelings while they were still deciding what to do.
The unsettled crew spent some time ashore. Rysn used the stop to reach Vstim by spanreed, and Rushu and Huio used his discovery to build her a floating chair.
As they neared Akinah, Rysn confronted Nikli and Plamry, held them and left them on Aimia's main island.

The Wandersail got through the strange storm around Akinah fairly easily, and Chiri-Chiri at once dived into the sea after luckspren. Lopen and Rushu explored the city and found its Oathgate in a cavern under a false one. Nikli attacked Rysn and Cord, who got away, and luckspren guided them to the Dawnshard.

On the beach, Nikli's huge hordeling and then many smaller ones surrounded Huio and some sailors. Lopen came back to help, and when Lopen was about to die, Huio swore his Third Ideal and saved them both.

Meanwhile Rysn became the Dawnshard that had been kept in a mural. Nikli and two other Sleepless came into the caverns, and Rysn and Cord bargained a treaty with him. The crew got away alive, carrying a few hordelings on board.
On the voyage home, Lopen challenged Huio about his Third Ideal and then swore his own.
Besides the Dawnshard, the expedition found Soulcasters and Shardplate. Three of the Soulcasters went to Alethkar and five to Thaylenah. Some months on, Rysn told Vstim about Dawnshards.
